official.deadline_note: The 2027 application round runs 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027; every applicant must file through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System.
official.status_note: The Fund publishes that the 2027 TaiwanICDF Scholarship applications open from December 1, 2026 to March 15, 2027; the window is not yet open at the verification date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The TaiwanICDF will cover the tuition fee as required by the student's university, and credit fees will also be covered as required by the student's university.
benefits: Round-trip airfare arranged by the TaiwanICDF with economy class, most-direct flights to and from Taiwan
Tuition fee and credit fees as required by the student's university
Accidental and necessary medical insurance for the entire duration of the programme
Textbook costs as required by instructors, subject to approval of the director of the student's institute
Monthly allowance for food and miscellaneous living expenses: NT$15,000 per month (bachelor's), NT$18,000 per month (master's), NT$20,000 per month (PhD), deposited monthly into a local bank account
eligibility: Outstanding students from partner countries of the TaiwanICDF
Applicants to degree programmes at universities collaborating with the Fund through the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) framework
requirements: Complete the online application through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System between 1 December 2026 and 15 March 2027
Applicants must ensure that they submit accurate and complete information; failure to do so will result in the application not being processed
coverage: Full scholarship including airfare (round-trip), housing, tuition, credit fees, insurance, textbook costs and a monthly allowance provided by the TaiwanICDF to each student within the award period
application_method: Complete the online application in the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System (application dates 1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027)
Ensure all information submitted is accurate and complete
official.application_route: Apply online through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System during the 1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027 window
official.citizenship_residency: Open to students from TaiwanICDF partner countries
official.international_eligibility: For students from partner countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan at collaborating universities
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Degree programmes at universities collaborating with the TaiwanICDF through the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA)
official.description: Central to the TaiwanICDF, the International Higher Education Scholarship Program offers full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan through collaborations with local universities, supporting the socio-economic growth of partner countries through the cultivation of highly talented individuals since 1998 under the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) framework.
official.program_type: Development-aid scholarship from an international cooperation fund

verification.notes: The programme page and Apply Now page on icdf.org.tw confirm full scholarships, TICA partner universities, the online application system and the 1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027 window. The entitlement itemisation (airfare, housing, tuition, credit fees, insurance, textbooks and a monthly allowance of NT$15,000/18,000/20,000 by degree level) comes from the Fund's official Scope of Scholarship document; because the allowance varies by degree level and tuition is paid as required by each university, no single funding_amount is published. Guideline-level details are in the 2026 Application Guidebook PDF, which did not render as text during verification.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a genuine full ride - round-trip airfare, dormitory housing, tuition, credit fees, insurance, textbooks and a monthly allowance of NT$15,000 (bachelor's), NT$18,000 (master's) or NT$20,000 (PhD) - but only at universities in the TICA network, so you apply to those specific programmes rather than to any Taiwanese university. The 2027 window opens on 1 December 2026 and closes on 15 March 2027 through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System, so use November to line up your documents. Download the official Application Guidebook and the Scope of Scholarship PDFs from icdf.org.tw before applying, because the detailed eligibility rules, document list and programme catalogue live in those documents rather than on the HTML page.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants from TaiwanICDF partner countries seeking a fully funded English-taught bachelor's, master's or PhD at a TICA partner university in Taiwan.
application_readiness_checklist: Download and read the 2026 TaiwanICDF Scholarship Application Guidebook and Scope of Scholarship PDFs from icdf.org.tw before the window opens
Review the 'Programs Available for Application' document to shortlist TICA partner university programmes
Prepare every document listed in the guidebook in advance of the 1 December 2026 opening
Create your credentials for the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System
Diarise the 15 March 2027 deadline and submit well before it
Double-check every field for accuracy and completeness, since incomplete applications are not processed
common_rejection_risks: Applying from a country outside the Fund's partner-country list
Incomplete or inaccurate information, which the Fund states stops the application being processed
Applying to non-TICA universities or programmes not in the annual application list
Leaving the online system submission to the final days of the window
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Per the Fund's Scope of Scholarship, the award covers airfare, housing, tuition, credit fees, insurance, textbooks and a monthly allowance; anything beyond these entitlements is at your own cost
document_audit: The required document list lives in the Application Guidebook PDF, not on the webpage, so check it early
The application is online only, through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System
Allowance amounts differ by degree level, so confirm which tier your programme falls under
Textbook purchases need approval from the director of your institute
alerts: The 2027 round opens only on 1 December 2026 and closes 15 March 2027
Housing is in student dormitories, so the award assumes on-campus residence
Tuition and credit fees are covered 'as required by the student's university', so the exact value depends on your programme
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online via the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System between 1 December 2026 and 15 March 2027, following the Application Guidebook's document and programme requirements.
